related.title: DDD Bounded Context：語意邊界與防腐轉換層
related.titleEn: DDD Bounded Context: semantic boundaries and translation layers
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 events.csv、snapshot.json與全量/快照重播一致性證據。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver events.csv,snapshot.json and full/snapshot replay equivalence.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 以product_id與有效日期查轉換表，輸出3箱→36件、3箱→24件，保留原數量及unit。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Resolve conversion by product_id and effective date,producing36 and24 pieces while retaining source quantity and unit. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units；對照 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
從零重播與從e2後快照120接續e3兩路結果均140；每個事件最多套用一次。

基準 3*12 = 36 pieces；對照 3*8 = 24 pieces。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
以product_id與有效日期查轉換表，輸出3箱→36件、3箱→24件，保留原數量及unit。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units; comparison 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Full replay and replay from the post-e2 snapshot120 followed by e3 both yield140;apply each event at most once.

Baseline 3*12 = 36 pieces; comparison 3*8 = 24 pieces. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Resolve conversion by product_id and effective date,producing36 and24 pieces while retaining source quantity and unit.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FreeBSD Capsicum：能力模式下的檔案存取
related.titleEn: FreeBSD Capsicum: file access in capability mode
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 events.csv、snapshot.json與全量/快照重播一致性證據。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver events.csv,snapshot.json and full/snapshot replay equivalence.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 列初始化與進入能力模式後兩階段，標出每次名稱解析的發生位置；把輸出寫入限制成已授權fd。
related.differenceEn: Separate initialization from capability mode, mark when each name lookup occurs and constrain output writes to an authorized descriptor.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units；對照 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
從零重播與從e2後快照120接續e3兩路結果均140；每個事件最多套用一次。

能力模式限制全域命名空間操作；先取得的描述元可作受限資源入口。沙箱邊界應由可用權限推導。
本課數值核對：10-2 = 8 removed_resources；另一項核對：2/10 = 0.2 remaining_ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units; comparison 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Full replay and replay from the post-e2 snapshot120 followed by e3 both yield140;apply each event at most once.

Capability mode constrains global namespace operations; preopened descriptors provide restricted resource access. Derive sandbox boundaries from available rights.
Numeric audit: 10-2 = 8 removed_resources; second audit: 2/10 = 0.2 remaining_ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
